finalText:
**Build's clean now.** Exit 0, 8 warnings, 0 errors.

Two real bugs from the bump, both link-stage crashes, not noise:

- [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
- [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) threw on `undefined` flags. New config loader leaves unset flags undefined instead of `false`. Now treats `undefined` as disabled.

The 8 remaining warnings are deprecation noise from the dep bump itself, unrelated to these bugs.

Next: nothing. Build passes.
